description: This file defines a Java class named LoginRequest that represents a data transfer object for login credentials with email and password fields and their corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: A Java class encapsulating login credentials with email and password fields.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address associated with the login request.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address for the login request.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password associated with the login request.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the login request.
